svg.aria-label: Infrastructure: a Kubernetes cluster in which the operator’s controller manager, in wireguard-system, reconciles the Wireguard and WireguardPeer custom resources in an application namespace and applies the server’s key Secret, ClusterIP Service and Deployment — a server pod with a sysctl init container, the WireGuard agent and a gluetun sidecar — while each app pod’s wg-client sidecar registers its own WireguardPeer with only its public key and tunnels to the Service, and the server egresses through a VPN provider outside the cluster; the sidecars, gluetun and the egress are designed but not yet implemented.
svg.text: One Operator, One Gateway: What Runs Where
The operator turns a Wireguard into a server Deployment, Service and Secret; each app pod registers itself as a WireguardPeer and keeps its private key.

text.tspan: • Watches every Wireguard and WireguardPeer; reconciles on each change.
• Gives each peer a /32 from the server’s peerCIDR (default 10.8.0.0/24).
• Applies the server’s Deployment, ClusterIP Service and key Secret.
• Writes the server key and the peer list into that Secret, which the agent mounts.

svg.text: Clients and their server share one namespace

text.tspan: • Each pod mints its own key; only the
public half is registered.

svg.text: Applied by the operator, owned by the Wireguard

text.tspan: • sysctl turns on IP forwarding before the agent starts.
• The agent reads the peer list from the Secret and keeps wg0 in step with it,
adding and removing peers by public key.
• gluetun connects to the provider with credentials from a Secret; the agent
forwards wg0 to its tun0.
• With tun0 down, traffic from wg0 is dropped, not leaked.
Shipped in the operator today
Designed, not yet implemented
A path that is designed, not yet implemented
• One Wireguard makes one server: a Deployment, a
ClusterIP Service and a Secret.
• App pods attach to a server in their namespace;
the sidecar needs NET_ADMIN.
• Private keys stay in the pod’s memory; only public
keys reach the API.

svg.text: Drawn from the minimal VPN gateway design (2026-10-29) and the operator’s code; dashed parts are designed but not yet implemented. The application namespace is the design’s worked example, media.
